short: Counting a small slice of stock often instead of everything at once.
seoTitle: Cycle Count — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: Cycle counting checks a small subset of items frequently — daily or weekly — instead of counting everything at once. Part of the free Setu business glossary.
definition: Cycle counting checks a small subset of items frequently — daily or weekly — instead of counting everything at once. Fast-moving and high-value lines are counted often, slow lines rarely.
bodyHtml:
Why Cycle Count matters

Full counts are disruptive, so they get postponed, and problems age. Cycle counts catch discrepancies within days, when the paperwork to explain them still exists.

How Cycle Count works in practice

Use ABC analysis to set frequency: A items weekly, B monthly, C quarterly. Rotate through the list so everything is covered over a cycle, and investigate variances the same week.

faq.question: Does cycle counting replace a full stock take?
faq.answer: It reduces how much a full count finds, but most businesses still do a full count at year end.

faq.question: Which items should be counted most often?
faq.answer: The ones where value times movement is highest — that is what ABC analysis identifies.
